name: hdf-libs
description: Heimdall Data Format Libraries - Universal security scan data format
author: MITRE Corporation

scripts.build: pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run build:go
scripts.test: pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:go
scripts.check: pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:go && pnpm run lint:timestamps && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run security
scripts.security: pnpm run security:ts && pnpm run security:go
scripts.security:ts: echo '── prod deps (fail on moderate+) ──' && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=moderate && echo '── dev deps (fail on high+) ──' && pnpm audit --dev --audit-level=high
scripts.security:go: pnpm --filter hdf-cli run security:vuln && pnpm --filter hdf-cli run security:sast
scripts.lint:go: pnpm --filter hdf-cli run lint && pnpm --filter @mitre/hdf-converters run lint:go && pnpm --filter @mitre/hdf-utilities run lint:go
